question.text:
Identify the valid statements relevant to the given circuit at the instant when the key is closed.
A. There will be no current through resistor $R$. B. There will be maximum current in the connecting wires. C. Potential difference between the capacitor plates A and B is minimum. D. Charge on the capacitor plates is minimum. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

solution.text:
Capacitor behaves like closed circuit at $t=0$ and charge is zero.
$\mathrm{A} X, \mathrm{~B} \checkmark, \mathrm{C} \checkmark, \mathrm{D} \checkmark$
